PR-102.bug: Daily total ignores pending transfers, so the daily limit can be bypassed by sending many transfers before settlement.

PR-103.bug: History endpoint never checks ownership: any user can read any account's transfers (IDOR).

PR-104.bug: Amount parsing goes through float: '19.99' becomes 1998 cents.

PR-105.bug: The new warning log writes the full recipient IBAN (PII) to application logs.

PR-106.bug: Statement export still reads memo; dropping the column breaks CSV export and destroys customer memos irreversibly.

PR-108.bug: Refactor removed the fee refresh on transfer-type change: switching to Instant still shows the SEPA fee.

PR-109.bug: Idempotency lookup is no longer scoped to the user: a key collision returns another customer's transfer id and skips the payment.

PR-110.bug: round() on Decimal is banker's rounding: fees on half-cent amounts drop by one cent (e.g. EUR 752.50 -> 150 instead of 151).
